## Set up

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(brms)
library(ggeffects)
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(ggtext)

#Load in clean data set
df <- read.csv("RC2026_KRAT_DATA.08.01.csv")
head(df)
```

## Look at Individuals across time

```{r}
unique(df$Tag)

Tag_counts <- table(df$Tag)
Tag_counts[Tag_counts > 1]

```
